hindi: माना $\overrightarrow{r}$ एक सदिश है जिसके लिए $\overrightarrow{r}\times\left(\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k}\right)=-4\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{r}\times\left(2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k}\right)=3\hat{i}-6\hat{k}$ है। तब $\left|\overrightarrow{r}\right|$ बराबर है
solution: $x=2z$ and $x+z=3\Rightarrow z=1,\ x=2$; then $y=2x-2=2$; all six equations hold

Each equation alone is a line: $(\overrightarrow{r}-\overrightarrow{b})\times\overrightarrow{a}=\overrightarrow{0}$ with $\overrightarrow{b}=\hat{i}+2\hat{k}$, and $(\overrightarrow{r}-\overrightarrow{d})\times\overrightarrow{c}=\overrightarrow{0}$ with $\overrightarrow{d}=-2\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-\hat{k}$; $\overrightarrow{r}$ is their common point
solution_full: Note first that $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot(-4,3,2)=-4+6-2=0$ and $\overrightarrow{c}\cdot(3,0,-6)=6-6=0$, as needed for each equation to have solutions.

Each triple alone has rank two: the first describes the line $\overrightarrow{r}=\hat{i}+2\hat{k}+s\overrightarrow{a}$ (since $(\hat{i}+2\hat{k})\times\overrightarrow{a}=-4\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$), the second the line $\overrightarrow{r}=-2\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-\hat{k}+u\overrightarrow{c}$.
Check all six: $-2-2=-4$, $2+1=3$, $4-2=2$, $2+1=3$, $2-2=0$, $-2-4=-6$. So $\overrightarrow{r}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+\hat{k}$ is the unique common point of the two lines ($s=1$, $u=2$).
$\left|\overrightarrow{r}\right|=\sqrt{4+4+1}=3$. (Options (A) and (B) are the lengths of the base points $\hat{i}+2\hat{k}$ and $-2\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-\hat{k}$ of the two lines.)
originality_note: New: two vector equations of the form r x a = p, each of which alone describes a line, are imposed together, so r is the intersection point of two lines given only through their moment vectors (way 5). Closest known: the published problem r x a = b x a, r x b = a x b, where adding the equations gives r parallel to a+b. Different because: the right sides are given as plain vectors with no common structure, so the shortcut does not apply and the student must solve for the common point.

concept_use.Vector Equation: The two vector equations r x a = p and r x c = q are solved simultaneously (componentwise, or as two lines whose common point is r).

stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line and plane is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy and numpy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan; the options have one form and exactly one is correct. Checked that each equation is consistent (a.p = 0, c.q = 0) and that together they have exactly one solution (rank 3). Changed: No change.
key_step: Solving the two cross-product equations together (or reading each as a line and intersecting).
justification: A routine but multi-step solve of a vector equation system; no insight needed once components are written. Comparable with the cross-product system of 2025-P1-Q16 (L2).
